events.text: CORRECTION: the commit sha is 5b3ced872 (the --shas value on the review move was a pre-commit guess and is wrong; disregard 62b1ad30f).

resolution: Diagnosed the 7 Hz capture rate as three stacked throttles and removed all of them: (1) the JS loop serialized result-processing before scheduling and enforced a 90ms start-to-start floor — now pipelined (resubmit the instant a result lands, before solve/push work, synchronous re-tick when over budget) with a 33ms pacing floor; (2) the ONNX session had zero options set — now 4 intra-op threads, full graph optimization, and spin-waiting disabled so idle inference threads stop fighting the frame loop; (3) the 442KB input tensor was page-allocated every solve — now persistent scratch. Added 'XXms infer · YYms rtt' to the tracking status line so the remaining bottleneck is readable on screen: if infer stays high the next lever is a faster model variant, if rtt-infer is big it's the result pump. Ship + headless shot PASS; the real rate number needs the user's OBS run.
